playoff.note: top six qualify: 1st and 2nd go straight to the semi-finals, 3rd-6th play a single-leg quarter-final round at the higher seed

conflicts: The 2026-27 season infobox says 247 matches, which cannot be right for 14 clubs playing 39 matches each (273 in total); the round count and the 39-match statement are used.
notes: 14 clubs, three rounds (each club meets every other club three times) = 39 regular-season matches, 273 in total; the season runs September 2026 - May 2027. 2026-27 marks a return to the pre-COVID three-round format: 2022-23 to 2025-26 used two rounds (26 matches). Bottom two are relegated to the JFF Championship, top two of the Championship come up. Single row, so closed both ways. The championship is decided by a six-team play-off, not by the table. The JPL is sanctioned by the JFF but run by PFJL (Professional Football Jamaica Limited).
